output.one_liner: A low-code platform for building databases and applications with structured data, automations, and native AI agent integration via MCP.

auth.notes: OAuth2 for user-facing applications, static API keys for direct REST API access, and Personal Access Tokens sent as Bearer tokens for CLI and server-side setups.

evidence.snippet: Our MCP server supports two authentication methods: OAuth (recommended for end-user connections) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs)

access.notes: MCP server and API credentials available to all Airtable users on all plans; self-serve OAuth integration setup and PAT creation in developer hub at no cost.

evidence.snippet: The server is available to all users on all plans.
Sign in to Airtable and open the Airtable developer hub

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 5 requests per second per base for create record operations

evidence.snippet: Tool to create multiple records (up to 10) in a specified Airtable table. Use when you need to add new rows.
Any MCP-compatible tool can read, write, and query your bases through natural language, scoped to your existing permissions.
Rate limit: 5 requests per second per base.
Airtable's MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that allows AI tools to securely connect to external data sources.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials with OAuth2 and API keys, comprehensive documented REST API with 28 implemented Composio tools, and official MCP server available to all users.

overview_evidence.snippet: Airtable's structured field types, relational links, and built-in automations make it a rich data layer for AI agents.
